Wire `--exclude` to its required environment default so CI can configure exclusions through the environment.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that skips matching filenames and logs each skip at info level. It documents the flag and adds tests for parsing, filtering, and archive contents.
